scientific_question: Does the deployed one-percent qk-headwise/v/c_proj BlockFHT chart contain the dense Muon attention optimizer path and exact applied directions on the smallest MAI ladder?
registered_order: run a fresh matched 124M dense Muon 0.5TPP attention trajectory with exact phase-boundary optimizer probes
run quantitative layerwise PCA/curvature analysis on attn.c_attn and attn.c_proj
project dense phase chords and exact Muon directions into the production BlockFHT tangent
compare exact tangent chord energy against the equal-rank Haar expectation
select at most one smallest repair from the measured failure mode
trajectory_polling: foreground poll to terminal because this is a 238-update 124M diagnostic; do not attach it to the long-run watchdog

decision_rule.blockfht_specific: If exact tangent chord energy is not above the equal-rank Haar expectation, treat BlockFHT orientation/local repetition as implicated and test one equal-coordinate global orthogonal chart.
decision_rule.capacity_specific: If capture is above Haar but materially below 10%, increase or reallocate only the deficient QK/V/c_proj coordinates according to measured target-level capture.
decision_rule.optimizer_specific: If chord capture is adequate but projected exact Muon-direction recovery is poor, test weight-space Muon pullback/preconditioning rather than more random capacity.
decision_rule.paper_recipe_specific: Only after tangent fit is established, test one paper-derived local-geometry term: meaningful centered per-output modulation or attention-logit stability, not the paper's degenerate scalar row modulation.

forbidden_shortcuts: no learned dense basis or LoRA-like adapter
no long-run promotion before a stable terminal 124M gain
